title: Cracks deepen in AIADMK dissidents’ camp
description: Former Law Minister and leader of the rebel camp C.Ve. Shanmugam stays away from an official review meeting for Villupuram, while former Food Minister R. Kamaraj attends the event for Tiruvarur. Besides these districts, Edappadi K. Palaniswami takes stock of the party’s performance in Salem and Tiruvallur (south)
